title: Bumping Thumping Dumping
description: Bumping Thumping Dumping — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Convince DJ Bumping and Thumping that he needs to get off the stage, because no one likes his music anymore. He is playing in The Cold Cave tonight and every night!

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Bumping Thumping Dumping

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Convince DJ Bumping and Thumping that he needs to get off the stage, because no one likes his music anymore. He is playing in The Cold Cave tonight and every night!

Offer:

CAN YOU FEEL IT? I STILL FEEL IT, AND IT FEELS TERRIBLE. IT SOUNDS LIKE LIVE MUSIC FROM THE COLD CAVE. MY EARS, BODY AND SOUL JUST CAN'T TAKE IT ANYMORE!

GO MAKE IT STOP!

COME BACK HERE TO BALZACK'S BASE CAMP AND LET ME JAVIER KNOW WHEN I CAN TAKE OUT THE EAR PLUGS!

Turn-in:

Much better, I was finaly able to take the earplugs out. Thank you.

Objectives:

  • Bumping and Thumping

Level range: 57–100
